messages:
Avery (CS): Quick sync - Pelmora week1 private/VPC onboarding. Main asks: 365d audit log retention, quarterly KMS rotation proof (PDF), and cross-account role for uploads. Any immediate blockers?
Samir (CSE): Preflight done. CIDR 10.40.0.0/22 assigned. Customer requested an extra /28 for bastion. Need clarity on Splunk collector path (peering vs. proxy).
June (SRE): Peering established on our side (pcx-0b2c3d). Waiting on Pelmora to add reciprocal route. NAT gateway created ngw-07 in us-east-1a. Asked them to open TCP/4503 -> splunk.ingest.redwood.net.
Omar (Security): KMS: Pelmora wants BYOK (customer CMK) with grants. I'll send a minimal key policy and grant steps. For rotation evidence we will run CloudTrail query, export CSV -> render to PDF, add signed attestation, and upload to S3 with a presigned URL.
Avery (CS): @Omar please paste the policy snippet so I can share with Pelmora SecOps.
Omar (Security): Snippet (replace ARNs): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::PELMORA:role/RedwoodKMSUser"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:CreateGrant","kms:ListGrants"],"Resource":"*"}]}`. Recommend enabling automatic rotation and adding cloudtrail:LookupEvents for the audit role.
NetBot: Route table rtb-0c applied to subnet-priv-02, NAT gateway ngw-07 created :white_check_mark:
Samir (CSE): IAM: please create cross-account role RedwoodProvisioner with sts:AssumeRole for arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/deploy-bot and s3:PutObject limited to s3://pelmora-logs/redwood/. Share role ARN for dry-run.
Lena (Account Exec): Renewal at ~45 days. Pelmora is evaluating a larger commit if onboarding and audit artifacts are clean within two weeks. Delay on peering or rotation evidence is our main renewal risk.
Pelmora (Customer): We'll push the reciprocal route today and share the role ARN. Can the rotation PDF include the AWS CLI query and timestamp? Need it for our SOC portal.
Omar (Security): Yes - we'll include the CloudTrail query, raw CSV, and a signed PDF with timestamps. Presigned URL valid for 21 days.
DeployBot: Dry-run started 2024-10-10T08:30:00Z step 2/4 succeeded (kv cache warmup); peering:pending
June (SRE): Confirmed peering accepted on our side; showing pcx-0b2c3d active. Still waiting for Pelmora acceptance event and their route table ID.
Samir (CSE): Plan for dry-run after we get role ARN: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn <ARN> --role-session-name test` then `aws s3 cp testfile s3://pelmora-logs/redwood/test/`. I'll report results.
Avery (CS): Action items: 1) @June follow peering ack and collect route table id 2) @Omar finalize key policy + rotation export + PDF attestation 3) @Samir validate assume-role + s3 put 4) @Lena track renewal cadence with legal. I'll send consolidated note to Pelmora and schedule check-in Fri 9am PT. Closing thread once route + ARN + presigned URL received. :white_check_mark:
